notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Pirate" on Malcolm to "Dragon" or "Wizard" until end of turn.
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Quicksmith Genius triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 3.
